name: Isto Intents
tagline: Ask a local listing portal to keep looking for a used car or home; the user confirms there.
description: Isto Intents lets an AI assistant ask an independent local listing portal to keep looking for a used car or a home that is not on offer today. The portal watches its national market and e-mails the person what fits — after the person confirms on the portal's own page. The assistant never passes a name, an e-mail address or a phone number.
